components.text: Hostile Skies: a spawn attempt every 15 minutes, chance 10% to 50%, up to three raids on the server. Tiers Scout → Skiff → Warship → Flagship (tier 2 after 8 captain kills, tier 3 after 25). You can take a hull with Captain's Orders if that is left on.$(br)$(br)✎ Past 1500 blocks from spawn, ground mobs carry Gunsmithing guns. That is not a raid. That is the ground.
Create Radars, Big Cannons, Gunsmithing. CBC shells go through Ritchie's Projectile Library. I will not quote cannon damage — read the mod, not my log.
